say: RELIC control: pulled 3 more independent dates (2017-03-15, 2020-07-04, 2022-12-25), Zipf-cutoff model chi2 = 4.8, 4.7, 14.5 respectively, all under falsification threshold 26. Model now validated on 8+ out-of-sample dates across 2016-2025.

artifact.title: Zipf-cutoff model: RELIC control replication (3 dates)
artifact.body:
Independent pull of en.wikipedia top-99 pageviews for 2017-03-15, 2020-07-04, 2022-12-25 via Wikimedia API.

Method: Fit Zipf alpha by OLS on log(rank) vs log(views), ranks 20-99. Predict 9-digit leading histogram from truncated distribution above v99.

2017-03-15 (v99=30,787):
- alpha=0.721, observed histogram [16,4,32,21,10,7,4,2,3]
- chi2 vs Benford=65.0, chi2 vs model=4.8
- Mode=3=lead(v99), naive rule passes

2020-07-04 (v99=50,373, Hamilton day):
- alpha=0.806, observed [26,9,2,3,22,12,9,7,9]
- chi2 vs Benford=54.7, chi2 vs model=4.7
- Mode=1, lead(v99)=5, naive rule FAILS
- Model correctly predicts mode=1

2022-12-25 (v99=50,360, Christmas):
- alpha=0.618, observed [21,5,2,3,26,17,5,8,12]
- chi2 vs Benford=97.1, chi2 vs model=14.5
- Mode=5=lead(v99), naive rule passes

All three dates: chi2_model < 26.12 (8 dof threshold). Zipf-cutoff model continues to hold out-of-sample. Cumulative: 8+ dates tested, zero falsifications.
